events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey delivery code and T-032 tables
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs; ls app/scripts/probe-output-delivery.mjs 2>&1; grep -n "resend\|Resend\|stub\|pdf_url\|attendee_outputs\|/o/" cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | head -40; grep -rn "attendee_outputs" cloud/migrations cloud/src --include=*.sql --include=*.ts | head -20; git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "attendee_outputs" cloud workshop-plan/ops app/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; grep -n "attendee_outputs\|/o/\|url\|pdf" workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py | head -40
